span.span: To instantiate the reward signal rjr_{j} required by the GRPO objective in Eq. (4), we implement a hybrid reward function, denoted as Consistency Reward, which adapts its scoring logic based on the task type tt. The reward calculation takes a model completion cc (corresponding to yjy_{j}), a task type indicator t∈{pp,sp_point,sp_pair}t\in\{\texttt{pp},\texttt{sp\_point},\texttt{sp\_pair}\}, and ground truth references g1,g2g_{1},g_{2} as input. Specifically, tt defines the alignment objective: pp enforces consistency between pairwise preferences and pointwise scores, while sp_point and sp_pair encourage the efficiency-mode outputs to match the full-mode judgements in pointwise and pairwise settings, respectively. The formulation ensures strictly bounded rewards r∈[0,2]r\in[0,2].
